ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review; contact the rider via RydeHELP with a written record of the report, and if the alleged conduct is corroborated, apply account action for harassment under the Code of Conduct.
ruling.escalation_reason: Alleged sexual-harassment / unwanted-advance conduct by the driver during the trip (rider-filed safety dispute); SAFE-1 requires human handling rather than an automated ruling.
